title.rendered: God Shall Supply ALL Your Need — Not Some, ALL | Morning Devotional

excerpt.rendered: God’s supply is not measured against the size of your problem — it’s measured against the size of His glory. Today’s devotional on Philippians 4:19 will completely reframe how you see your needs.

content.rendered:
Gospelbuzz Morning Devotional — Thursday, April 2, 2026

📖 Scripture for Today

“And my God shall supply all your need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus.”
— Philippians 4:19 (NKJV)

✝️ Devotional Message

The word “all” in the Bible is one of the most important words in the Christian’s vocabulary — and also one of the most commonly doubted. We believe God supplies some needs. We believe He helps with most things. But all? That is where faith gets tested.

And yet God — through Paul — is crystal clear: ALL your need. Not some. Not the spiritual ones. Not the ones that seem godly enough to bring to God. ALL. Financial need. Physical need. Relational need. Emotional need. The need you are almost embarrassed to bring before Him. ALL.

Now notice something else — the standard against which God measures this supply. Not according to your faith level. Not according to how good your week was. Not according to the size of the church you attend. According to His riches in glory. His supply is calibrated to the unlimited, inexhaustible, eternal storehouse of heaven — not to your bank account balance or the state of the economy.

Andrew Wommack has preached powerfully on this: God is not stingy. He is not reluctantly dipping into a reserve. He is a Father who takes pleasure in providing for His children — and the measure of His provision is His own infinite glory. There is no shortage in heaven. There is no recession in the Kingdom. His riches are never depleted.

Flourish Peters often reminds his congregation: stop sizing God’s provision against the size of your problem. Size His provision against the size of His glory. And when you do that — the maths always works in your favour.

Whatever you need today — bring it. His supply is already on its way, and it is more than enough.

🙏 Prayer for Today

Father, I thank You that You are my supply — not the economy, not my employer, not my circumstances. Your riches in glory are inexhaustible, and You meet every need I have. I bring my needs to You today — all of them — and I trust You to supply. You are Jehovah Jireh, my Provider. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

📣 Daily Declaration

“My God supplies ALL my needs — not some, not most, ALL. His supply is unlimited, His storehouse is full, and He takes pleasure in providing for me. I lack nothing because my Father lacks nothing!”
